title: WebGL gallery on a spring-snapped float index with a wheel step detector
summary: A float index pulled to a whole item by a spring (frequency `9.5`, damping `12`, fixed `1/240 s` substeps), each plate's depth, scale, yaw and opacity derived from `i − index`; a wheel step detector (noise floor `.3`, per-event cap `24`, threshold `6`, quiet gap `130 ms`, sustained repeat `480 ms` against a `550 ms` envelope) so one flick moves one item, the wheel released to the page at either end; drag coasting with friction `.89` into the spring; a carousel-role DOM mirror with a slide list, arrow / Home / End keys, `n / N` caption, live announcer; direct snaps under reduced motion
variants: tilted row: depth, scale and yaw read from each plate's distance to the float index (this, default)
ring: angle = (i − index) · 2π / N on a cylinder, the same spring and step detector
stack: z only, items behind the active one scale down and fade, for a deck of cards
